sources.title: Milling formulas and definitions
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 難切削材料冷卻加工
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付階次對照圖與顫振／強迫振動待驗假說。；教學診斷須正確追蹤齒頻並列出至少一項需實測的阻尼或相位證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver an order map and testable chatter-versus-forcing hypotheses.; Teaching diagnosis must track tooth frequency correctly and identify required damping or phase evidence.
related.difference: 從質量流率與溫升估算帶走熱量，辨認散熱不足與量測問題。
related.differenceEn: Estimate removed heat from mass flow and temperature rise and separate cooling deficits from measurement faults.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 齒通過頻率 ft=z n/60；自激顫振還需相位與穩定性分析。；離線訊號教學 z=4、n=3000 rev/min，結構候選模態為 180 Hz。；ft=4×3000/60=200 Hz，與 180 Hz 相差 20 Hz。
穩態顯熱 Qdot=mdot cp ΔT，不含相變與旁通。；教學 mdot=0.05 kg/s、cp=4000 J/(kg·K)、ΔT=5 K。；Qdot=0.05×4000×5=1000 W。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Tooth-passing frequency ft=z n/60; self-excited chatter needs phase and stability analysis.; Offline signal example: z=4, n=3000 rev/min and candidate structural mode 180 Hz.; ft=4×3000/60=200 Hz, 20 Hz away from 180 Hz.
Steady sensible heat Qdot=mdot cp ΔT, excluding phase change and bypass.; Teaching mdot=0.05 kg/s, cp=4000 J/(kg·K), ΔT=5 K.; Qdot=0.05×4000×5=1000 W.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 以理想抽氣模型研究腔體時間成本與漏氣底限，全程離線。
related.differenceEn: Study chamber cycle time and leak floor with an ideal offline pumpdown model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 齒通過頻率 ft=z n/60；自激顫振還需相位與穩定性分析。；離線訊號教學 z=4、n=3000 rev/min，結構候選模態為 180 Hz。；ft=4×3000/60=200 Hz，與 180 Hz 相差 20 Hz。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Tooth-passing frequency ft=z n/60; self-excited chatter needs phase and stability analysis.; Offline signal example: z=4, n=3000 rev/min and candidate structural mode 180 Hz.; ft=4×3000/60=200 Hz, 20 Hz away from 180 Hz.
Ideal leak-free p=p0 exp(−St/V), so t=(V/S)ln(p0/pf).; Teaching V=0.10 m³, S=0.010 m³/s and p0/pf=1000, using only a pressure ratio.; t=(0.10/0.010)ln1000=69.0776 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
